name: send_follow_up_email
description: Schedule the approved visitor, admin, and Insight intake email bundle for backend delivery only after the session closes and the final transcript is available. During a natural closing motion, ask once for permission to email the final recap and Visual Brief to the private website check-in address; never ask for, spell, repeat, or submit that email address. After email permission is resolved, ask once whether a phone follow-up would be useful. A visitor may optionally provide and explicitly confirm one callback number; otherwise omit it without pressure. Call silently with userConfirmed true, and include callbackPhone plus callbackPhoneConfirmed true only after the visitor confirms the number. Never claim email was already sent, a callback was scheduled, or a specialist was assigned.

userConfirmed.description: Must be true only after the visitor explicitly agrees during this conversation to receive Amy's follow-up email.

callbackPhone.description: Optional callback number spoken and explicitly confirmed by the visitor in this conversation. Never infer or copy it from private application data.

callbackPhoneConfirmed.description: Include only as true after the visitor explicitly confirms the callback number.
